units.source_text: 那针的舞蹈很有分量，让人感到那里简直就像地球的中心。

en.t: The dance of that needle carried a real weight, making him feel that this spot was almost the very center of the earth.

units.source_text: 机械反复，为现在涂上了彩色，把那手感当成确实的东西。

en.t: The mechanical repetition colored the present and made that sensation seem like something certain and real.

units.source_text: 于是，男人也不落后，拼命干一些更单调的家务活。

en.t: So the man, not wanting to fall behind, threw himself into even more monotonous household chores.

units.source_text: 清扫清扫天花板上的沙子啦，淘淘米啦，外加洗衣服，都已经成了男人每天的必修课。

en.t: Sweeping the sand from the ceiling, rinsing the rice, and even doing the laundry had all become part of the man's required daily routine.

units.source_text: 干起活来，还要哼哼小曲儿，时间就这么打发过去了。

en.t: Once he started working, he would even hum little tunes, and in this way the time passed.

units.source_text: 他甚至还考虑过睡觉时挂个小型的塑料布天幕，研究过怎样将鱼埋到滚烫的沙子里蒸烤，以此来消磨时间。

en.t: He even thought about hanging a small plastic sheet as a canopy while he slept, and studied how to bury fish in the scorching sand to steam-roast them, all as ways to kill time.
